data.one_liner: A stream-based reactive wrapper over shared_preferences for key-value storage.
data.what_it_does: Wraps regular shared_preferences to provide Streams for every stored key, allowing reactive listening of value changes. It also supplies a PreferenceBuilder widget to sync UI components seamlessly with persisted preferences.
use_when: You want to reactively listen to changes in shared_preferences across your Flutter app.
You prefer simple key-value local storage without heavy SQL setup.
avoid_when: You need complex relational querying, indexing, or encryption.
You are already using an all-in-one state management and persistence solution that doesn't use shared_preferences.
strengths: Comes with a convenient PreferenceBuilder widget to reduce boilerplate.
Supports custom objects and serialization via JsonAdapter.
weaknesses: Change detection only works on the Dart side through this package's API.
Limited to key-value storage use cases.
data.setup_notes: Call WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized() before obtaining the StreamingSharedPreferences instance.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you do not need reactive streams and prefer the traditional non-streaming key-value API.

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a faster, pure Dart NoSQL key-value database with built-in reactive boxes.
